title: Q8
description:
Read: Exo 12:12-13, Exo 12:21-30, Jos 2:8-21, Jos 6:17, Jos 6:22-25

Blood on the door and a scarlet cord are both a mark before a destruction. One house is under the ban of a city devoted to destruction.

a) What does each mark do for the people inside, and what does the cord add that the blood on the door does not?
